label: Толстый / Тонкий
description: Толстый vs тонкий: thick/thin contrasts across genders and everyday scenes.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative agreement. 'Толстый' takes the masculine ending to match 'словарь', describing a thick book. The sentence anchors the object sense in a familiar item.
Strategic focus: Masculine nominative agreement. 'Тонкий' matches masculine 'блокнот', meaning thin. The sentence places the form in a simple possessive context.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative agreement. 'Толстая' takes the feminine ending to match 'книга', describing its thickness. The sentence pins the object sense to a concrete noun.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative agreement. 'Тонкая' matches feminine 'тетрадь', meaning thin. The sentence anchors the form in a small spatial scene.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative agreement. 'Толстое' takes the neuter ending to match 'одеяло', describing a thick blanket. The sentence ties the object sense to a cosy household item.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative agreement. 'Тонкое' matches neuter 'полотенце', meaning thin. The sentence shows the ending switching inside a concrete room description.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative agreement. 'Толстые' takes the plural ending to match 'стены', describing thick walls. The sentence anchors the object sense in a building scene.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative agreement. 'Тонкие' matches plural 'ветки', meaning thin. The sentence places the form in a natural outdoor image.

missions.phrase: Этот журнал толстый, а тот тонкий.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Direct thick-vs-thin contrast for objects. Both 'толстый' and 'тонкий' match masculine 'журнал', setting a thick magazine against a thin one. The sentence puts the two opposite endings side by side.

Strategic focus: Masculine agreement in the body sense. Here 'толстый' matches masculine 'человек' and means fat rather than thick, the secondary people sense of the adjective. The sentence shows how толстый shifts meaning from objects to a person.
